nom: Peach Slices L-Glutathione Glow On Brightening Toner

avis.texte: so I was nervous to get this based of the comments regarding the smell but I'm glad I didn't let those comment scare me away. I'm loving this toner, the first initial toner using it had strong smell. I haven't noticed it anytime after that. I already see a noticable difference in my dark spots.

avis.titre: Who cares if it smells, it WORKS
avis.texte: Other reviews arent wrong, per say - this product has a rather unpleasant smell. But it is also incredibly effective for lifting the PIH marks on my face from healed breakouts, plus you get used the smell the more you use it. Love it so much, definitely will repurchase.

the reviews are true, this toner has a sulfuric (egg-y) smell but i only notice it directly in the bottle not once applied, its super leightweight and provides a nice glow! i have oily combo acne prone skin and havent noticed any irritation or breakouts so yay! overall it gives my skin a small boost of hydration and a lil glow without being heavy or greasy, so far i really enjoy it and my skin seems to like it also and ots fairly affordabley priced so thats a win

Ended up returning this because I noticed every time I used it my skin just looked really greasy and oily at the end of the day. Not "glowy" or anything just kinda slimey. I did shake before using as i do with any skincare product and the smell is funky, as people note. Its not super string but just kinda smells like dull funky socks or something. I appreciate there is no added fragrance etc but personally i am more likely to use a product if its a sensorial experience and i cant look past bad smells.

this is a really nice toner! it keeps my skin glowy and hydrated without irritating my sensitive skin. the only downside for *some people* would be the smell. IMO, the smell isnt the worst thing ever. you only really smell it when opening the cap + putting the product onto a cotton pad/your hands. during application i dont smell anything, even when applying on my nose. this product SAYS there is no added fragrance- which is why it smells the way it does. id rather have a natural funky scent than a product with irritating fragrances. if you're sensitive or picky to some scents, this product probably isnt for you. but if youre the type of person that wants to use a product because it *works* well, and you dont care about smells, this would be a great toner for you!

avis.titre: Why don't you guys read directions?
avis.texte: Ive been using this product for roughly three weeks and have noticed an incredible change in overall tone/evening of complexion. Yes there is a smell from the active ingredient, L-Glutathione, it does preface in the directions. However, if you actually read them, it clearly states to shake the product before using. When shook, the smell is there, however it dissipates rather quickly. The strong smell you all are experiencing is from not shaking it thus the L-Glutathione is sitting on top. This toner is amazing, already purchased two backups

avis.titre: Simple, super gentle, smell is minor
avis.texte: Im actually a huge fan of this toner especially for the price. The active ingredient has a smell that is not super pleasant but its mild and this is fragrance free - I used it a few days after a laser procedure without issue thanks to that.

Y'all if you dont smell sulfer in your glutathione then its NOT good glutathione! Any slight snell gies away by the next product you apply. My skin LOVES THIS! Its calming and hydtating and it helps my vitamin c serum work better! This is a new holy grail for me and my skin LOVES that theres no added fragrances.

I couldn't bear the smell if this toner, it literally made me gag. I tried for several days and out my body thru torture for no reason. Didn't notice Amy glow or improvement. Shkd have purchased ELF OR Elemis

It literally says in the description that it has a potent scent and has no added fragrance. it doesn't smell that bad, and I'd prefer something to smell a little funky vs it having unnecessary added fragrance. and either the smell goes away after 5 minutes or it gets masked by your moisturizer... anyways I like the product, I haven't had any irritation or breakouts and my skin us usually pretty sensitive. it goes help to gently even out dark spots, but you have to be consistent. 6-8 drops on my cotton pad is enough to use over the whole face. I've used it for about a month just once every night, and can tell a small difference, which is saying something when I've tried products that are $50-80 that did absolutely nothing. could be a repurchase for me depending on the end result of once the bottle is empty.

I love this toner so much that I've already bought a back up! It soothes any redness I have on my face, feels hydrating and makes my skin look instantly brighter/glowier. It does smell musty but the scent goes away upon application and I prefer that over fragranced products. I love the minimal ingredient list!

Ive had this for just a few weeks and my skin has brightened up so much! Dark spots are fading, my skin is plump and luminous! This product has a smell becuase the active ingredient, Glutathione, has a very distinct smell. Anyone who has done any amount of research at all on this ingredient knows it unfortunately has a sulfur like smell. But It goes away in moments! If you for some reason cannot handle a weird smell for a few seconds, perhaps this isn't for you. And if that's the case, how unfortunate as this is a powerhouse toner! Definately worth the price and worked beautifully under all my serums and other toners so far! Great price point, bottle is easy to dispense, and it works!
I really love this toner, but it smells awful. I realize that does mean it is a good quality glutathione, but man it smells bad.

avis.titre: Started brightening my dark spots within days
avis.texte: I love all of peach slices' products, have been using them for years now and with this new toner, I noticed that my acne dark marks started fading after about a week of use. It wasn't dramatic, but definitely noticeable. I only use this product at night due to the smell, but compared to another product I used that contained glutathione, this product's smell isn't that strong.
Omg the smell…. It smells like sewage. Used it twice and both times i had to hold my breath. I dont know how it will perform otherwise but i cannot tolerate this smell.

I literally was only able to use this twice before i had to return it. It smells like garlic steak seasoning and i genuinely gagged both times i used it. I havd no idea if its even a good product in terms of brightening but anyone sensitive to smells shouldn't bother trying it.

I have been using this toner for a week now and I am blown away! It feels so calming and soothing on my skin, it is SO lightweight and hydrating and I might be crazy but I see more even skin tone just after a week! I love that it has encapsulated glutathione in it! I haven't been able to find that in an affordable version. This is my new #1 toner!
